name: Edward Heartfield
original_name: エドワード・ハートフィールド
source:
The unidentifiable old gentleman who is killed in front of the protagonist. 

Losing all memories of his past and where he's from, he contacts the protagonist, who can look into the memories of people, in order to help him regain his memories. However, he is murdered by someone.

Hometown: Unknown
